notes: Draft content for the story-layer spec. Personas are illustrative households, not real people.

A persona's numbers are never typed here. Each quarter they are computed from simulation output for the persona's districts: rent = district median rent per m2 x dwellingSize; income = the incomePercentile point of the district household income distribution used by the ghost rule; commute = commute matrix minutes from homeDistrict to workDistrict.
Template states follow the ghost thresholds in params.json (ghost.rentThreshold, ghost.commuteThreshold). Placeholders in braces are filled by the narrative code; numbers are formatted by the UI.
Text follows neutrality.md: what the numbers are, no verdicts, no causes. Causes are shown only in the Why? view.

personas.name: Ting
personas.intro: Ting is 25 and works at an office in Xinyi. She rents a 13 m2 studio in Zhonghe, where rents are lower, and rides the MRT across the river each morning.
personas.picker: 25, renter in Zhonghe, works in Xinyi

personas.name: Mrs. Lin
personas.intro: Mrs. Lin is 72 and lives alone in a small rented flat in Wanhua, near the market she has used for forty years. Her income is a pension. She does not commute, so rent is the number that matters to her.

personas.name: The Huangs
personas.intro: The Huangs both work, one in Banqiao and one in Zhongshan. With two children they need a three-room flat, which they rent in Banqiao. They are saving for a home of their own.
personas.picker: Dual-income family of four, renters in Banqiao

personas.name: Kai
personas.intro: Kai and his partner rent a flat in Tamsui, which has more space for the money. Kai works in Neihu, at the other end of the MRT network.
personas.picker: 31, renter in Tamsui, works in Neihu

personas.name: Mei
personas.intro: Mei works at a restaurant in Da'an and rents a room a few streets away. She walks to work. Living close costs more each month than living farther out.
personas.picker: 34, renter in Da'an, works in Da'an

personas.name: Hao
personas.household: single parent with one child, renting
personas.intro: Hao is raising his daughter alone. They rent a two-room flat in Sanchong, and Hao works in Zhongzheng, one bridge and a few MRT stops away.

rent.below: {name} spends {rentBurden}% of household income on rent this quarter.
rent.atRisk: {name} spends {rentBurden}% of household income on rent this quarter, above the {rentRiskThreshold}% line that housing agencies use for a cost burden.
rent.ghost: {name} now spends {rentBurden}% of household income on rent, above {rentGhostThreshold}%. In the district average this does not show: {name} is one of the people the average hides.

commute.below: {name}'s trip from {homeDistrict} to {workDistrict} takes about {commuteMinutes} minutes each way.
commute.atRisk: {name}'s trip from {homeDistrict} to {workDistrict} takes about {commuteMinutes} minutes each way, longer than the {commuteRiskThreshold} minutes most commuters say they accept.
commute.ghost: {name}'s trip from {homeDistrict} to {workDistrict} takes about {commuteMinutes} minutes each way, more than {commuteGhostThreshold} minutes. Over a working month that is about {commuteHoursMonth} hours on the way to and from work.

comparison.same: This is the same as in real history.
comparison.lower: In real history the rent share was {rentBurdenReal}%. Under your policies it is {rentBurdenDiff} points lower.
comparison.higher: In real history the rent share was {rentBurdenReal}%. Under your policies it is {rentBurdenDiff} points higher.
comparison.range: Depending on the study used, the simulated value lies between {rentBurdenLow}% and {rentBurdenHigh}%.

stateChange.becameGhost: This quarter {name} crossed the line. On the map, {name}'s district gains a ghost for every {ghostSize} people in the same situation.
stateChange.leftGhost: This quarter {name} moved back below the line.
stateChange.becameGhostReal: In real history {name} would have crossed the line in {realQuarter}.

ending.summary: From 2015 to 2025, {name} spent {quartersAtRisk} of 44 quarters above the {rentRiskThreshold}% rent line, compared with {quartersAtRiskReal} in real history.
ending.commuteSummary: {name}'s commute averaged {commuteAvg} minutes, compared with {commuteAvgReal} minutes in real history.
ending.ghostSummary: {name} was a ghost for {quartersGhost} quarters ({quartersGhostReal} in real history).
ending.closing: Other households in {homeDistrict} had different results. The district panel shows how many people were above the line in each quarter.
